advice.note: Brown concentric spots on lower leaves in about a third of the plot. Recommended Amistar Top 200 ml/acre, two sprays 12 days apart. Plain product pitch, no field comparison shown.

visits.objection: price too high — ₹1,480 per bottle for 6 acres

advice.note: Leaf blight starting on 2 of 4 acres. Recommended Amistar Top 200 ml/acre, repeat after 12 days. Plain product pitch.

visits.objection: price too high — ₹1,480 for one bottle, will wait and see

advice.note: Premium spray at half dose did not stop blight. Switched to Blitox 50 WP 500 g/acre, two sprays 10 days apart. Pitched as ₹420 per acre per spray.

Blight now on all 4 acres after no spray in April. Advised Blitox 50 WP 500 g/acre, two sprays 10 days apart. Showed yield data from Srinivas Yadav's plot next door: blight stopped within 10 days of Blitox, pickings back to normal.
Water stood for days in low patches last kharif. Advised summer deep ploughing and a field drain on the canal side before sowing.
Second borewell gives water only 2 hours a day in May. Suggested drip for the next maize crop and asked him to check the horticulture department subsidy.

visits.objection: drip is costly, will decide after kharif

advice.note: Dry chilli rate at Warangal fell to about ₹14,000/quintal. Advised cold storage at Shamshabad instead of a distress sale.
Khaira (rusty brown patches) seen in last kharif paddy; soil card shows low zinc. Advised zinc sulphate 10 kg/acre basal at puddling.
Bore holes on about 8% of green fruits. Advised Proclaim 80 g/acre and removing damaged fruits.
Heavy weed flush after first rains. Advised Glycel burn-down before sowing only, never over the crop.
Pink bollworm hit his cotton hard in August 2025. Advised timely sowing of a BG-II hybrid and not extending the crop into January.
Soil card shows low phosphorus. Advised DAP 50 kg/acre basal at sowing.

visits.objection: wants to use leftover complex fertiliser from last year

advice.note: Window-pane feeding and frass in whorls on about 15% plants. Advised Proclaim 80 g/acre directed into the whorl.
Advised RCH 659 BG-II and early sowing; bollworm damaged his bolls last August too.

visits.objection: prefers neighbour's brand of hybrid seed

advice.note: Pale yellow seedlings after heavy June rain leached the soil. Advised first urea top dressing now, second at squaring.
Fresh whorl damage on about 20% plants. Advised Proclaim 80 g/acre.
Nursery leaves showing brown spots typical of zinc deficiency. Advised zinc sulphate 10 kg/acre basal in the main field.
Upward leaf curling on young transplants. Advised Confidor 100 ml/acre. Reminded him with yield data: his April switch to the standard spray saved his last two pickings.
Early monitoring before the usual August attack. Advised 5 pheromone traps per acre; spray only if more than 8 moths per trap for 3 nights.
Leaf curl starting on border rows. Recommended Confidor 100 ml/acre. Plain product pitch, no yield comparison.

visits.objection: price too high, will try neem oil first

advice.note: Jassid hopper burn on leaf edges. Advised Ulala 60 g/acre. Framed as ₹430 per acre versus losing squares; showed last year's yield gap from unsprayed plots.
Rosette flowers on about 10% plants. Farmer says pink bollworm came in the same week of August last year. Advised Profex Super 400 ml/acre, repeat in 10 days.
Aphids and jassids above threshold. Advised Ulala 60 g/acre.
Traps crossed threshold (11 moths/trap for 3 nights); rosette flowers on about 12% plants, same as August 2025. Advised Coragen 60 ml/acre.
Leaf blight spots after a week of cloudy weather. Advised Blitox 50 WP 500 g/acre. Showed yield data: Srinivas and Ramesh both controlled blight with Blitox in April at ₹420 per acre.
Uniform yellowing, leaf colour chart reading 3. Advised urea top dressing now.
First visit. Rosette flowers on about 8% plants. Advised Profex Super 400 ml/acre and 4 pheromone traps per acre.
Early blight spots on kharif chilli. Farmer asked for Blitox himself after the April result. Advised Blitox 50 WP 500 g/acre at first spots, not after spread.
Second flush of pink bollworm; damaged green bolls on about 12% plants despite earlier spray. Advised Coragen 60 ml/acre.
A few rosette flowers (about 4% plants), lower than Moinabad. Advised Profex Super 400 ml/acre.
Oval grey lesions on sheaths near the water line in dense patches. Advised Tilt 200 ml/acre and draining the field for 3 days.
Sheath blight lesions in 3 of 12 acres. Advised Tilt 200 ml/acre on the affected blocks.
Downward leaf curling and tiny mites under leaves. Recommended Oberon 160 ml/acre. Plain product pitch.
Blight came back after 5 days of heavy rain. Advised Blitox 50 WP 500 g/acre again, spray only on a dry forecast.
Yellowing in canal-end plots. Advised second urea top dressing now.
Rainfed field, 18 days without rain, squares and small bolls shedding. Advised mulching with crop residue and not spraying anything until rain.

New growth without curl.

Sucking pests below threshold.

Spots dried up; no new infection after one spray.
